constraints: Require resolved visibility and inclusion policy plus description provenance before rendering current catalog entries.
Exclude private URLs and local paths from the public projection; keep catalog provenance markers consistent and eligible entries rendered exactly once.
Preserve the generated README contract and explicit renderer boundary; refresh/catalog operations do not authorize autonomous publication or personal claim changes.
Keep source evidence, interpretation, current external release claims and owner review distinct; local generated-output tests do not establish live public visual readback.
bindings.handoff_review: Own catalog policy validation and deterministic README projection. Inventory/provider sources own reported repository facts; the owner owns personal claims and publication. README is generated, so Compass changes stay in .project-compass without appended prose. Evidence limit: Tests assert policy, provenance, private URL rejection, exact-once rendering and stale markers; live public readback and current release validation remain open.

decisions.summary: Proposed exact-path translation of existing canonical local validation/projection behavior; no change to existing root intent.

Accepted source association to the existing root outcomes, grounded in .project-compass/contract.json and the unchanged .project-compass/contract.json intended source provenance. Detailed source review and independent batch-1 review on 2026-09-11 establish these exact implementation/proof associations. This adopts no new product intent, changes no maturity, closes no runtime gaps, and grants no release authority. Installation and final diff review remain separate task gates.
